title: Evaluating invariance training with certified answer-changing controls in neural graph algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2611.23907v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Invariance training aims to make neural algorithmic reasoners robust to answer-preserving input changes and is judged by accuracy and by how rarely such edits change predictions. We ask whether this evaluation detects lost sensitivity to answer-changing edits on minimum spanning trees of synthetic graphs, where both directions can be certified. Attaching a subgraph through one bridge provably preserves every original label. Attaching it through two edges, oracle-selected to change a label, and lowering one weight inside the graph serve as answer-changing controls; a response is a changed prediction on an edge whose label changes. A reproduced graph transformer (GDT) within its published accuracy range changes a provably fixed label on 53.3-65.9% of the 64-vertex graphs it solves exactly after a 64-vertex bridge attachment; removing the connecting edge changes little. translated_title: 在神经图算法中利用可认证的答案改变型对照评估不变性训练
translated_abstract: 不变性训练旨在使神经算法推理器对保持答案不变的输入变化具有鲁棒性，其评估依据是准确率以及此类编辑极少改变预测的程度。我们提出疑问：这种评估能否检测出模型对答案改变型编辑的敏感性丢失，研究对象是合成图上的最小生成树问题，其中保持答案与改变答案两个方向均可被严格认证。通过一条桥边附加子图，可证明所有原始标签保持不变；而通过两条由预言机选定以改变某个标签的边附加子图，以及降低图内部某条边的权重，则作为答案改变型对照；所谓“响应”，是指在其标签确实发生变化的边上产生了不同的预测。一个处于已发表准确率范围内的复现图Transformer（GDT），在经过64顶点桥边附加后，在其能精确求解的64顶点图中，有53.3%–65.9%的图在可证明保持不变的标签上出现了预测改变；而移除连接边则几乎不引起变化。在16顶点图及其附加实验中，三种不变性目标降低了……（摘要原文至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用可严格认证的“答案改变型”对照来评估神经算法推理器的不变性训练，发现满足已发表准确率的图Transformer在桥边附加后会在过半可精确求解的图上改变可证明不变的标签，揭示现有不变性评估会掩盖模型对答案改变型编辑的敏感性丢失。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces certified answer-changing controls for evaluating invariance training in neural graph algorithms, showing that a reproduced graph transformer within its published accuracy flips provably fixed labels on 53.3–65.9% of the graphs it solves exactly after bridge attachments, revealing that current invariance evaluations fail to detect lost sensitivity to answer-changing edits.
